replication.target_description: good earning capacity; ranking task; GDI; participant-sex × gender-equality interaction from linear mixed model controlling for Galton’s problem, with country and geographic-region effects, age/sex predictors; 2986 participants from 36 countries.

n.exclusions: Age missing or outside 16–60 (927), not exclusively heterosexual (1212); rating task additionally excludes 35 participants lacking all three trait ratings; only countries with more than 9 participants analyzed. Printed task-specific analytic n retained without deriving counts.

notes: Original title and replication title verified in full texts. Original p values are significance-footnote bounds; unmarked cells have no numerical p printed. Replication source is the original OSF DOCX primary file (culture_sex_differences.docx; OSF file 5c0671029de61900191a5397), parsed read-only into the shared text cache. Exact table/row locations are used because DOCX has no reliable printed page numbering. GDI is the replication paper’s Gender Development Index, selected by its authors for similarity to the older Gender-Related Development Index. The GDI interaction matches the intended outcome/task and index family in the supplied replication locator. Narrative verdict concerns the attempted gender-inequality replication overall; the uncontrolled GII/ranking earning-capacity analysis was an explicitly qualified exception (p = .027), not the Table 1 test extracted here. Replication estimates are printed model coefficients; gender-equality variables were standardized by the authors. Methods reports the task-specific analytic samples used here despite different abstract/initial-sample totals.
